name: Bith na Bró
description:
A world laid over a transformed Earth. Its land, its seas and the magic in it hold in every age; the powers, peoples and places of each age are that age's own: the First Empire, between one and two thousand years ago, and the Antenexus, the present.

**The globe.** Real coastlines are run through a heavily rotated Mercator projection and read back as an ordinary one (pole 50.27°E 10°S, seam 150°E 50°S, south compression 0.5, E/W compression 0.55). Climate follows a tilted hot axis through the remapped British Columbia, Dakotas and Texas, not in-world latitude; moisture follows nearness to the remapped sea.
